questions.question: During the celebrations of which national festival is the ‘Beating Retreat’ ceremony held in New Delhi?
National Food for Work Programme, aimed at intensifying supplementary wage employment, was launched in which year?
Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana was launched on 1st October 2020 with which of the following objectives?
options: Incentivise government for creation of new infrastructure.
Incentivise employers for creation of new employment.
Incentivise employers for creation of Make in India products.
Incentivise governments for reduction in corporate taxes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Incentivise employers for creation of new employment.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the festival that is celebrated as the resurrection of Jesus Christ after his crucifixion?
Tamarind, which has medicinal properties, contains high levels of ________, sugar, vitamin B and calcium.
What is the key technology used in India's fastest and indigenously designed router launched in Bengaluru by Union Minister for Communications, Electronics and Information Technology in March 2024?
Which of the following is NOT one of the pillars of Sagarmala Programme?
options: Technology development for deep sea mining
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Technology development for deep sea mining) है।

questions.question: Which of the following was the aim of Fort William College founded by Lord Wellesley?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To train British civil servants) है।

questions.question: Who among the following has been appointed as the head of the expert government committee to finalise the uniform KYC norms in 2024?
As per Article 211, no discussion shall take place in the Legislature of a State with respect to the conduct of any ______.
options: Judge of the Supreme Court or High Court
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Judge of the Supreme Court or High Court) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the four main seasons in India based on the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) classification?
El Niño is an oceanic-atmospheric phenomenon that occurs in which ocean?
Which type of forests are present in the Western Ghats?
What is the function of the cytoplasm in a cell?
options: Suspension of organelles and cellular metabolism
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Suspension of organelles and cellular metabolism) है।

questions.question: As per the 44th Amendment, the Parliament can extend the duration of the President's Rule in a state for a period of ___________ at one instance.
What is the objective of the 'Skills on Wheels' initiative launched in September 2023 by the National Skill Development Corporation and IndusInd Bank?
options: To promote various trades in rural areas
To equip rural youth, particularly women, with digital skills
To improve agricultural practices through the use of technology
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To equip rural youth, particularly women, with digital skills) है।

questions.question: As per the Hindu lunar calendar, ‘Diwali’ falls on the 15th day of which month?

While participating in the Yoga Rally, a group of people started quarreling with religious comments over distribution of free yoga mats.Which of the Fundamental Duties is invoked from the other participants in such a situation?
options: To cherish and follow the noble ideals
To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood
To defend the country and render national service
To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood) है।
